title: A Cover for the Drop
author: Ansel Villalobos
blurb: Silas Brightwater, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
